params.name: Input
params.description: The geometry that receives values: each of its points takes them from the nearest point of the From geometry.

params.name: From
params.description: The geometry to copy point attributes and groups from, by nearest point. Nothing is copied if it is unconnected or has no points.

params.name: Attributes
params.description: Comma-separated names of the point attributes to copy. Empty copies every point attribute the source has.

params.name: Transfer Groups
params.description: Also copies point group membership from the nearest source point, so points join or leave each group to match the source.

params.name: Groups
params.description: Comma-separated names of the point groups to copy. Empty copies every point group the source has.

params.name: Maximum Distance
params.description: Points further than this from any source point, in world units, receive nothing. 0 means no limit.

params.name: Group
params.description: Only points of the input in this group receive values. Empty lets every point receive.
